bundle.shortDescription: Ultra-lightweight WhatsApp Web client for Linux
bundle.longDescription: Wafy is an open-source, ultra-lightweight desktop messaging client for Linux wrapping WhatsApp Web with Tauri v2, Rust, and WebKitGTK for maximum memory efficiency.
